title: T-1 lifecycle events fire on facadeReady kvHit kvMiss kvWrite with metadata-only payload
iWant: the facade to emit facadeReady kvHit kvMiss kvWrite events with metadata-only payload on the injected sink
soThat: the applied logging companion can render KV activity without ever writing a body byte to the log stream

acceptanceCriteria.description: Each lifecycle event emitted by the facade carries EXACTLY the whitelist {event, key, size, ttl, timestamp}. No body value, no metadata blob, no additional field ever appears on the record the sink receives.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the facade wired to a spy event sink, with a mix of put/get/delete/list operations
acceptanceCriteria.then: the sink records each event with only the whitelist keys; any extra key trips the probe
